# Skin Blinker

**Category:** Player  
**Aliases:** Skin Blinker, SkinBlink

## What it does

Causes your Jacket Layer to blink

Description basis: [publisher description](https://impactclient.net/features). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).

## Client variants

### [Impact — Skin Blinker](https://impactclient.net/features)

Causes your Jacket Layer to blink

Basis: [publisher description](https://impactclient.net/features).

### [RusherHack — SkinBlink](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/SkinBlink.html)

Flash skin layers on and off

Basis: [publisher description](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/SkinBlink.html).

### [Future — SkinBlink](https://www.futureclient.net/#features)

Basis: [publisher description](https://www.futureclient.net/#features).
